column1: # Native 53.16 PE world-map site-card productions. Addresses are RVAs.
# Three native branches reuse these fields: hover 0x1c2000..0x1c3a00,
# compact action header 0x1c7700..0x1c8c00, and news/site detail 0x1ce800..0x1cfc00.
# Corresponding classic literal instructions in these branches are Steam RVA - 0x70.
# Title dark/race/type branches are recorded in world-site-type-sources.tsv.
# The title is The [dark ][RAW race adjective ]type of name; compact uses name, type.
# Title words are capitalized after assembly. Name/government/civilization values are
# native generated names; no world/save-specific spelling is a source production.
# Travel cost comes from 0x1bc2d0. For cost >= 18, cost/9 is converted to a native
# number phrase by 0x52e360, capitalized by 0x52d650, then suffixed with days' travel.
# Population rows select the first matching lower bound in descending order.
# Scheduled tribute uses relation.type (+4)=3/4 and season (+0x44)=0..3.
# They offer/accept, the season, and tribute are separate draws on the same row.
# Missing/out-of-range season draws no season; the existing unscheduled caption remains.
# Relationship fallback switch is 0x1cf7e0, table 0x1d39b0: types 0..5.
# Seasonal relation first takes precedence; fallback type 0 also tests flags +0x40 bit 2.
# News history is a separate rumor producer at 0x1da280..0x1dbcec, called at 0x1cfa75;
# its screen+0x8310 rows start at y=12 and are recorded in world-site-rumor-sources.tsv.
# Prisoner and artifact list entries use native figure/artifact names; their headings
# belong to the hover branch. Native mission availability captions occupy its bottom.
